note: Fictional hardship policy. v15 lowers the agent's waiver limit from 50.00 to 40.00.

v14.text:
4.1 Decline when the monthly surplus (income minus expenses) is 200.00 or more and no hardship is stated.
4.2 A documented hardship may have late fees waived, up to the fees outstanding.
4.3 A reviewer may approve a partial waiver.
4.4 A payment plan may spread payments over at most 3 months.
5.1 A hardship agent may approve waivers up to 50.00 and payment plans; a hardship lead up to 200.00.
5.2 Whoever raised an exception may not approve it.
